action_items: No API-bearing criteria in this matrix (static portfolio, no login/backend data) - no backend pytest lane required.
6 acceptance criteria in briefing covered by 14 checks total (4 new + 10 regression re-runs); matrix size is under the 8-criterion threshold so full coverage was completed without a count note.

checks.name: pdam-carousel-desktop
checks.evidence: At 1280px: 5 dot indicators present, counter starts 01/05; next-button advances to 02/05 (Login loaded); dot-5 jumps to 05/05 (Kelola Tagihan loaded); previous-button returns to 04/05 (Customer Detail loaded); dot-3 selects 03/05 (Dashboard Admin loaded) with aria-current tracking active dot. All 5 PDAM screenshots (Splash, Login, Dashboard Admin, Customer Detail, Kelola Tagihan) confirmed loaded via img.complete && naturalWidth>0.

checks.name: sport4all-swipe-circular
checks.evidence: At 390x844: dispatched TouchEvents on project-01-sport4all-carousel. Swipe left (300->100) advanced 01/04 -> 02/04. After resetting to slide 1, swipe right (100->300) wrapped to 04/04 (circular). No horizontal overflow (scrollWidth<=clientWidth) after either swipe.

checks.name: pdam-swipe-circular
checks.evidence: At 390x844: dispatched TouchEvents on project-02-pdam-carousel. Swipe left (300->100) advanced 01/05 -> 02/05. After resetting to slide 1, swipe right (100->300) wrapped to 05/05 (circular). No horizontal overflow after either swipe.

checks.name: project-visual-compact-sizing
checks.evidence: Desktop (1280px) bounding-box heights: Sport4All 345px, PDAM 345px, Sports App Wireflow placeholder 250px - all <=390px cap. Mobile (390px) heights: Sport4All 345px, PDAM 345px, placeholder 185px - all <=360px cap. All three visuals stayed visible/readable with no overlap.

checks.name: project-presentation
checks.evidence: 3 project cards rendered. project-01-sport4all-carousel and project-02-pdam-carousel are both visible with zero matching visual-placeholder nodes for 01/02. project-03-visual-placeholder is visible with caption containing 'replaceable visual', confirming Sports App Wireflow intentionally still placeholder while Sport4All and PDAM ship real assets.

checks.name: hero-portfolio-identity
checks.evidence: Rerun persisted check passed: greeting, full name, headline, CTA, profile photo frame, AVAILABLE FOR PKL and OPEN TO NEW IDEAS badges present and non-overlapping.

checks.name: hero-profile-photo-quality
checks.evidence: Rerun persisted check passed: profile photo loaded (complete && naturalWidth>0), portrait crop confirmed, PKL badge does not intersect face zone.

checks.name: sport4all-carousel-desktop
checks.evidence: Rerun persisted check passed: 4 dots, counter cycling 01->02->04->03 via next/dot/previous, all slide images loaded.

checks.name: sport4all-carousel-mobile
checks.evidence: Rerun persisted check passed: carousel fits within 390px viewport, no horizontal overflow before/after next-button, dot-1 returns to 01/04.

checks.name: pill-navigation-anchor-flow
checks.evidence: Rerun persisted check passed: NV monogram, all four desktop nav links, anchor URLs/sections, active-state assertions intact.

checks.name: mobile-navigation-project-flow
checks.evidence: Rerun persisted check passed: desktop links hidden on mobile, hamburger opens menu, Project link navigates to #project, menu closes.

checks.name: about-and-skills-content
checks.evidence: Rerun persisted check passed for RPL/UI/UX copy and Figma, Canva, CapCut, Adobe Illustrator, Lightroom skill groups.

checks.name: contact-actions
checks.evidence: Rerun persisted check passed: email text/mailto link and LinkedIn/GitHub destination links intact.

checks.name: responsive-stability
checks.evidence: Rerun persisted mobile check passed: menu usability, project navigation, no horizontal overflow before/after navigation.
